versions.content: AUTOSAR Standardized Abstract Meta-Classes AUTOSAR standardized abstract meta-classes are specified by abstract UML classes (ab- stract=true) that are not representing primitive types (no stereotype «primitive», «enu- meration») in the AUTOSAR Meta Model [19], sub-packages M2::AUTOSAR DataFor- mat or M2::MSR. The reference is established via the name of the UML classes.
